# BusterMan Decoder

A DigitalEnigma text decoder for Flipper Zero with an animated character and saved XP progression.

- Decode Hex, Base64 and ROT13 text.
- Run small Brainfuck programs with bounded execution.
- Try Auto chain for layered Hex, Base64 and Brainfuck input.
- Enter text on the Flipper or preview and decode a text file.
- View results, earn XP and save progress between sessions.

## Controls

Use Up and Down to select a mode, OK to enter text, Right to inspect a text file, and Back to return or exit. The Flipper text keyboard makes Brainfuck punctuation cumbersome; the desktop GUI can help with input.

## Optional desktop integration

CyberKing can synchronize progress and use the USB bridge while BusterMan is open. The bridge reads capture files and transfers them to the desktop; desktop jobs require the companion software. Standalone text decoding needs no extra hardware or software.

[DigitalEnigma website](https://d3cyberking.com)
